The role will be responsible for maintaining service quality, managing operational performance, coordinating service teams, monitoring service-level agreements, and driving continuous improvement across service operations. The ideal candidate will have strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and operational management skills. The Service Delivery Manager will act as a key point of contact between customers, business teams, technical teams, vendors, and management to ensure services are delivered reliably, efficiently, and in line with agreed requirements. Key Responsibilities Manage the end-to-end delivery of services, ensuring agreed service standards, requirements, timelines, and performance targets are consistently achieved. Develop and maintain service delivery processes, procedures, standards, and operational frameworks aligned with business and customer requirements. Act as the primary operational contact for key customers and stakeholders regarding service performance, incidents, escalations, requests, and improvement initiatives. Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, business stakeholders, service teams, suppliers, and external partners. Define, monitor, and report on Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), service quality, availability, response times, resolution times, and customer satisfaction. Review service performance regularly and identify gaps, recurring issues, operational risks, and opportunities for improvement. Lead service review meetings with customers and internal stakeholders, providing performance updates, issue summaries, improvement plans, and action tracking. Coordinate service delivery teams across IT, operations, technical support, infrastructure, applications, customer service, and other relevant functions. Allocate resources and priorities according to service requirements, business needs, incidents, projects, and operational demands. Monitor service requests, incidents, problems, and escalations to ensure they are handled within agreed service levels. Take ownership of major service incidents and coordinate appropriate teams to minimise business disruption and restore services as quickly as possible. Lead or support incident reviews and root-cause analysis to identify underlying problems and implement preventive actions. Coordinate problem management activities and ensure recurring incidents are properly investigated and addressed. Develop service improvement plans to increase reliability, efficiency, performance, customer satisfaction, and operational consistency. Work closely with technical and operational teams to monitor system availability, service performance, capacity, infrastructure, applications, and other service components where applicable. Ensure service delivery processes are properly documented and that operational procedures, escalation paths, support models, and responsibilities are clearly defined. Coordinate service transitions for new systems, applications, projects, customers, or operational changes to ensure smooth handover into business-as-usual support. Participate in project planning and implementation activities to ensure operational and service requirements are considered before new solutions are deployed. Review project deliverables, support documentation, training requirements, service procedures, and operational readiness before service launch. Manage relationships with external vendors, suppliers, contractors, and managed service providers involved in service delivery. Monitor vendor performance against contractual obligations, SLAs, service quality, response times, and agreed deliverables. Escalate vendor-related issues and coordinate corrective actions where service performance does not meet expectations. Assist with service contracts, renewals, pricing discussions, operational requirements, and supplier performance reviews. Monitor service costs, resource utilisation, operational budgets, and opportunities for improved efficiency. Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, streamline workflows, improve service processes, and reduce operational overhead. Gather and analyse customer feedback, complaints, surveys, service data, and operational metrics to identify improvement opportunities. Ensure customer complaints and service concerns are addressed professionally, transparently, and within agreed timelines. Prepare regular service performance reports, dashboards, management summaries, and customer reports. Present service performance, risks, incidents, trends, improvement initiatives, and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders. Maintain accurate records of incidents, service requests, SLA performance, problems, changes, risks, customer feedback, and improvement actions. Ensure service operations follow relevant company policies, security requirements, compliance standards, data protection requirements, and governance procedures. Support business continuity, disaster recovery, service resilience, and operational risk management activities where applicable. Develop and maintain service continuity and escalation procedures for critical services. Coach and support service delivery teams to improve performance, accountability, communication, and customer service. Establish clear team objectives and monitor individual and team performance against agreed operational targets. Promote a customer-focused culture and ensure service teams consistently understand customer expectations and business priorities. Stay informed about industry trends, service management practices, emerging technologies, and operational best practices. Contribute to strategic technology, transformation, outsourcing, service optimisation, and business improvement initiatives. Continuously review service delivery processes and implement practical improvements that enhance service quality, efficiency, and customer experience. Requirements Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Operations Management, Service Management, or a related discipline. Proven experience in service delivery, IT service management, operations management, customer success, technical support management, or a similar role. Strong understanding of service management principles, SLA management, incident management, problem management, change management, and service improvement. Experience managing customer relationships and working with internal and external stakeholders. Strong knowledge of KPI measurement, performance reporting, service monitoring, and operational analysis. Experience managing service teams, technical teams, operational teams, or cross-functional resources. Strong incident management and escalation-handling capabilities. Excellent problem-solving, decision-making, and root-cause analysis skills. Strong understanding of ITIL or similar service management frameworks is preferred. Experience with service management or ticketing platforms such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Zendesk, Freshservice, or similar systems. Strong vendor and supplier management skills, including experience monitoring SLAs and contractual performance. Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Strong customer-service mindset with the ability to manage expectations and resolve complex service issues professionally. Strong organisational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret operational data and convert findings into practical improvement initiatives. Ability to work effectively under pressure, particularly during major incidents, escalations, and critical service disruptions. Strong leadership and team-development skills with the ability to coach and motivate service teams. Professional, proactive, and collaborative approach with strong attention to detail. Relevant certifications such as ITIL, PMP, PRINCE2, COBIT, or equivalent qualifications are advantageous.

You will partner with these business functions to understand requirements and translate these into Operational Tools. Digital Technology (Caledonian) Development of prototype local applications for SQDIP improvements. DT Technology and Operations Team (Cheltenham) Providing support for iPhone and iPad devices, including setup, upgrades, compliance, and issue resolution. Responsibilities also include managing a Raspberry Pi-based signage solution, covering procurement, build, and configuration of devices. Project activities may involve supporting application deployments and upgrades, as well as managing small-scale equipment deployments and installations. Digital Technology (Dowty) Improving how the business uses data and digital technologies to drive better decisions and performance. You will help enhance data maturity by improving data quality, structure, standardization, governance, and accessibility, and work with business and digital teams to understand reporting needs and develop dashboards and visualizations for key metrics. The position involves gathering, cleaning, validating, and analyzing data to support operational and strategic decisions, while identifying opportunities where AI can create business value and building clear business cases for adoption. You will research digital and AI trends and best practices, help evaluate AI use cases for impact, feasibility, risks, and data readiness, and lead or coordinate a digital technology project from scope definition through milestone tracking and stakeholder communication. Cyber Security (Cheltenham) You will work across five key cyber security areas: Intelligence, Enterprise Vulnerability Management, Insider Threat, External Threat, and Digital Forensics. The student will spend two months in each area, gaining an understanding of daily operations by working with key staff and delivering a small project to showcase what they have learned.
